description.value: Cafe Zen is a Kitsilano institution that has been serving honest brunch and lunch daily since 1989, earning a 4.4-star rating across 728+ reviews. Located steps from Kitsilano Beach on Yew Street, it draws regulars with rotating chalkboard specials, multiple eggs Benedict variations, and hearty breakfast plates at approachable prices. Touring cyclists finishing a ride along the nearby seawall or Vanier Park will find it a welcoming, unpretentious refuelling stop in the heart of the neighbourhood.
